needs: IAM_SHADOW_DIR (shadow_v1 tables of the joint windows)

reported.name: lnR
reported.label: R (nm)
reported.note: identifiable in the island / coalescence stage (about 3-30 s, misfit-transplant tests of 11-02: size P90 10-17 %, coverage within 0.05); later grains (Ag >= 80 s) not identifiable

reported.name: lnD
reported.label: D (nm)
reported.note: identifiable in the island / coalescence stage (about 3-30 s, misfit-transplant tests of 11-02: size P90 10-17 %, coverage within 0.05); later grains (Ag >= 80 s) not identifiable; D from the number density (not 2 pi / q*)

reported.name: cov
reported.expr: min(m.coverage + (m.n_s * float(sum(m.sp.wj * pi * m.sp.Rj ** 2)) if m.fs > 0 else 0.0), 1.0)
reported.label: coverage
reported.note: identifiable in the island / coalescence stage (about 3-30 s, misfit-transplant tests of 11-02: size P90 10-17 %, coverage within 0.05); later grains (Ag >= 80 s) not identifiable

reported.name: lnT
reported.label: height T (nm)
reported.note: absolute scale set by the mass factor and the deposition rate

reported.name: base_mass
reported.label: dense base mass (nm)
reported.note: absolute scale set by the mass factor and the deposition rate

reported.name: lnR_P
reported.label: radius of the film-density regions (nm)
reported.note: lateral size of the regions where the whole film is sparser / denser; meaningful only where lnA_P is above about -5

reported.name: lnA_P
reported.label: ln of the film-density fluctuation amplitude
reported.note: A_P = area share x (density difference / mean film density)^2; -13.8 = term off

reported.name: sH
reported.label: log-normal spread of the grain heights
reported.note: 0 = all grains of one height (the film fringe at the grain scale is sharp)
